insights.content: DTC #3 is 5-0, the only unbeaten team in the division. W5 win over Anthem was clean: Yarisbel dominated Rivera 6-1 6-3 at S1, Shi/Darian won D1 6-2 6-3, Emmy/Moon won D2 6-4 6-4, and Kara/Rachel ground out a D3 tiebreak. Only loss was S2 (Anna Clark 3.12 baseline lost to Anthem's Kelly Twells). DTC #3 now controls their destiny — win W7 vs Summerlin to lock first place.

TPC collapsed 0-5 to Summerlin. Summerlin, TPC, and Anthem are all 3-2 behind DTC #3. LTF beat Southern Highlands in the W5 makeup match to go 2-3 — Southern Highlands drops to 1-4. DTC #2 (2-3) beat Red Rock (1-4) 3-2. Summerlin is now the most dangerous team in Subflight A.

W7 (5/2) vs Summerlin is the must-win. Kim Springer (3.25→3.30, 3-2) leads Summerlin's roster. Tayoni Coleman (2.92→3.05, 4-0) is a genuine riser — she has climbed +0.13 from a 2.92 baseline. Tina Nathalia (2.91→3.08, 3-2) at D1 is another threat with a big rise from her real baseline. Yarisbel (3.10→3.18, 4-0) is the stronger singles player on ratings, but Summerlin's depth makes this a competitive match. This match decides first place.

Most underrated after W5: Shi Oskooi (2.74→3.11, 5-0, +0.37) and Darian McCauley (2.92→3.11, 4-0, +0.19) are both dominant at D1 — Shi's rise from 2.74 is the biggest in the division. Kelly Twells (3.01→3.15, 4-0) is Anthem's flex weapon and the division's top-rated active riser. Yarisbel (3.10→3.18, 4-0, +0.08) is winning comfortably but her rise looks modest because her baseline was already solid.
TPC (W6 opponent, 4/25) is no longer a serious threat. After the 0-5 rout, their roster has regressed. Expect a comfortable DTC #3 win in W6 — 4-1 or better.

Anthem put Maddux + Laudenslager at D1 against Shi/Darian — a mismatch they lost 6-2 6-3. Shi/Darian are now 4-0 together at D1, their only real test being the W1 tiebreak loss. Summerlin's Nathalia (2.91→3.08) + Springer (3.25→3.30) are the only pair in the subflight likely to push them.
Kara Gaston (2.96 baseline, 1-1) and Rachel Glaze (2.83 baseline) won D3 in W5 4-6 6-1 1-0 — Rachel's first competitive match (her W4 win was a walkover). Keep this pair at D3.

sections.title: 04/25 — next match preview: DTC #3 vs TPC

insights.content: DTC #3 (5-0) at TPC (3-2). TPC just got swept 0-5 by Summerlin. Their roster is thinner than their early-season results suggested. This should be a comfortable win.
TPC's S1 option is likely Amber Candelaria — she was bageled 6-0 6-0 by Coleman in W5. Yarisbel (3.10→3.18) should win comfortably.
TPC's D1 pair got crushed 6-3 6-0 by Nathalia/Springer in W5. Shi/Darian should win this handily.
DTC #3 wins 4-1 or 5-0. The only swing line is S2 — Anna Clark (3.12 baseline) vs TPC's S2. TPC's depth beyond Wang has not been impressive.
vs TPC (3-2). TPC just got swept 0-5 by Summerlin — no longer a serious test. Comfortable win expected.

vs SUMMERLIN ARBORS (3-2) — now the must-win. Yarisbel (3.10→3.18) vs Kim Springer (3.25→3.30) at S1 — Yarisbel rated higher but Springer is a 3.25 baseline player. Shi/Darian at D1 vs Nathalia/Springer is DTC #3's hardest doubles test of the season. This match decides first place.
vs SOUTHERN HIGHLANDS (1-4). Already beat them 4-1 in W2. Comfortable win expected.
vs RED ROCK CC (1-4). Already beat them 3-2 in W3. Should win 3-2+. Rhianna Schwartz (2.90→3.07, 2-0) is a riser for Red Rock — don't put a weak pair at D1.

DTC #3 is 2 games clear of everyone at 5-0. Win W6 (TPC, very likely) and W7 (Summerlin, competitive) to clinch 1st outright. Even losing W7 keeps DTC #3 in the driver's seat given the remaining schedule.
